ios.desc:
PUNCH TV is the ultimate team fight show! You get to focus on the combat without the chaos.

STORY Ascend the tower of champions, sixty-five stages of varying challenges and game modes (FFA, 1 on 1, Tag Teams)

ARCADE MODE: Classic 1 on 1 best of 3 rounds

FIGHTERS of every shape and combat style, 60 playable! Fireballs, piledrivers, spinning kicks, backfists, suplexes, leg sweeps, rapids, beasts, robots, shotos and everything in between!

PVP online with your team of 3 fighters against players from around the world or against AI.  *ALL PVP Characters have balanced stats, there is no 'pay2win' for this mode.*

COOP in real time, fight together with up to 3 players online in a series of coop-only stage battle.

Online netcode offers both 'Rollback' (good for under 100ms) and 'Async' (preferable for over 100ms).

Supports bluetooth controllers, cloud saving.  Internet connection isn't required but you forfeit some features by not being online.

If you're considering supporting Four Fats (all 4 of us), please consider the Starter or Premium upgrade and sharing the game with your buddies...and total strangers

At Four Fats, we aim to offer you an easy entry to the fighting game genre.  That's why our games are free to download - we do have in-app purchases for players that want them but they are not a requirement to enjoy the game as intended.

android.desc: Next update coming soon includes Arcade Mode, the return of 'Items' for your fighters (common to legendary), some new stages and characters - stay tuned PUNCH TV is the ultimate team fight show! You get to focus on the combat without the chaos. Compete with the best, solo or multiplayer. STORY Ascend the tower of champions, sixty-five stages of varying challenges and game modes (FFA, 1 on 1, Tag Teams). Story mode is designed as a single player, progression based experience. FIGHTERS of every shape and combat style, 55 playable! Fireballs, piledrivers, spinning kicks, backfists, suplexes, leg sweeps, rapids, beasts, robots, shotos and everything in between, one of the most competitive rosters of fighters you'll find anywhere! (Fighter movelist videos are being created on the official Four Fats channel and will be updated) PVP online with your team of 3 fighters against players from around the world or against AI. *ALL PVP Characters have balanced stats, there is no 'pay2win' for this mode.* (PVP 2.0 in the works) COOP in real time, fight together with up to 3 players online in a series of coop-only stage battle. A Four Fats multiplayer experience! We offer everyone 9 fighters for free so you can pick up and play! Online netcode offers both 'Rollback' (good for under 100ms) and 'Async' (preferable for over 100ms). The Story mode can be played Offline, with some limitations to drafting characters. When you connect online, your data will also be saved to the server as an extra level of safety. Supports bluetooth controllers, cloud saving. Internet connection isn't required but you forfeit some features by not being online. If you're considering supporting Four Fats (all 4 of us), please consider the Starter or Premium upgrade and sharing the game with your buddies...and total strangers At Four Fats, we aim to offer you an easy entry to the fighting game genre. That's why our games are free to download - we do have in-app purchases for players that want them but they are not a requirement to enjoy the game as intended. A fighting game for the ages.
